corpus.provenance: MAINLINE synthetic replica corpus (synthetic_replica, harness_only). Built by trappoint_recall.corpora.build.build_goldsets from committed fixtures. G2 is excluded by construction: a calibrator-only label has no place in a corpus a release gate reads. Retro judgements are distant supervision from investigator citations, overlaid with G3's human-confirmed blinded labels, which are the only labels p_at_block computes over.

split_policy.note: Corpus-level head. Each retro query additionally carries its own wall t, enforced by the predicates occurred_at < t AND ingested_at < t AND corpus_commit <= t. AS OF SYSTEM TIME is refused (gc.ttlseconds=4h, recall lead D12).

attribution.note: measured on channel C's own output. Channels A (deterministic ancestry) and D (lexical BM25) would add candidates and could move this number, but their absence does not excuse it: this red is a statement about this retriever.

gates.reason: point 0.2500 < 0.90; Wilson lower bound 0.1741 < 0.80 over n=96 severity-5 retro permits. A miss here is a fatality exhibit.
point 1.0000 >= 0.75, Wilson interval [0.8620, 1.0000] over n=24 blocking probabilistic checks

attribution.note: a majority of routine permits address a (site_id, activity_root) partition that holds no documents, so on those permits this arm cannot raise a false alarm at all. Whatever colour the gate reports, the number is substantially an artefact of corpus construction and must not be read as evidence about false alarms.

detail.criterion: >=1 probabilistic blocking check on a routine permit

gates.reason: point 0.0400 >= 0.03 over n=300 routine permits. A rule that breaches the nuisance ceiling is rejected rather than tuned.

attribution.note: MI16 bonded_fatalities_all_blocking is violated because channel B — bonded severity-5, admitted unconditionally with no threshold and no model in the path — is not implemented. A prefix-constrained vector search cannot promise that invariant and this backend does not claim to.

PRELIMINARY: no customer-grade floor is claimed at this checkpoint (BUILD_PLAN.md G4-alpha).
The time wall is enforced by predicates (occurred_at < t AND ingested_at < t AND corpus_commit <= t), never by AS OF SYSTEM TIME; the harness cannot enforce it inside a backend it did not write.

prefix_reachability.note: a single prefix-constrained ANN arm cannot return a document filed under a different (site_id, activity_root); the architecture's answer is an ancestor walk of k arms UNION ALL-ed and re-ranked, which this program does not build

routine_partition_occupancy.note: a nuisance rate measured over permits whose prefix partitions hold no documents is zero by construction; it is not evidence about false alarms, and the gate's sensitivity witness does not catch it because the witness is measured on the retro subset

text_uniqueness.note: documents sharing an embedding text share a vector exactly; their order inside an ANN result is decided by the query's tie-break, not by the model
